identity_review.result: Same single travelling trader; one closed satchel, green coat, ochre inner clothing, brown trousers/boots, short thick auburn braid. No new person, visible currency/stock, permission or completed transaction implied.
identity_review.limits: Card establishes narrative identity, not a pixel model sheet. Old177 appearance and supplied brief establish visual continuity.

visual_findings.result: Torso shortened substantially from old177, legs and separated soles readable. Candidate shares reference footprint, but the head/face reads elongated and straight frontal relative to the more directional compact reference faces; matching bbox is insufficient style evidence.

Single-pixel eyes and nose shadow are individually readable enlarged. At native size the face remains a bright mottled vertical mass; brows/cheeks/mouth need fewer coherent planes, and head pitch/direction should be reconciled with reference camera.
Both small empty hands remain separate from body; current 2px palm/thumb clusters are minimally readable. No reliable fingers or gripping action should be claimed.

One closed bag and diagonal shoulder strap are present; stripe crosses high-contrast waist/buckle region, giving multiple competing brown/gray clusters. Clean strap-to-flap junction and belt separation before production acceptance.
Short thick braid and green/ochre/brown identity survive. Braid tip is clearer enlarged than native; keep its separation from right shoulder while reducing face noise.

Clarify diagonal strap at waist/belt and where it joins the single closed satchel.
